basics.name: Manas Patel
basics.label: Senior Frontend Engineer / Full-Stack Platform Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Frontend Engineer with over 8 years of experience architecting high-scale single-page applications, UI platforms, micro-frontends, and distributed frontend systems across global tech leaders including Atlassian, Apollo.io, Coinbase, Walmart Labs, and Cisco. Specialized in React.js, TypeScript, Next.js, and performance engineering with proven impact driving multi-million dollar cost reductions and optimizing web vitals.

work.name: Atlassian
work.summary: Building and scaling core enterprise frontend products and distributed UI platform capabilities.
highlights: Architecting robust UI components and high-reliability frontend features across distributed cloud products.
Driving developer experience (DX), modern tooling adoption, and rigorous code quality across cross-functional pods.

work.name: Apollo.io
work.summary: Frontend platform engineering focused on build pipeline performance, Core Web Vitals optimization, and test automation.
highlights: Optimized frontend build pipelines by configuring Webpack and SWC, slashing build times by 20% and streamlining CI pipelines to reduce deployment time by 30%.
Reduced production bundle sizes by 25% through advanced code-splitting and tree-shaking, improving First Contentful Paint (FCP) and Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) by 10%.
Led enterprise version upgrade from React 16.x to 17.x, modernizing dependency management and DX while reducing user churn.
Architected end-to-end frontend code coverage framework from scratch using Cypress.
Integrated New Relic telemetry dashboards for real-time frontend static metrics, error tracking, and performance monitoring.

work.name: Coinbase
work.summary: Engineered workflow automation tools, ML platform interfaces, and enterprise cloud data architectures.
highlights: Led the frontend architecture of Bot Maker, an interactive visual workflow builder that automated complex business processes and saved ~$10M annually in operational expenses.
Designed and deployed internal developer platforms enabling Machine Learning and Data Science engineers to register, deploy, and monitor ML models with reduced manual overhead.
Spearheaded the design and POC development of an AWS Neptune graph database to evaluate centralized, high-throughput blockchain data indexing at company scale.

work.name: Walmart Labs India
work.summary: Full-stack frontend and API layer engineering for global e-commerce platform Asda.com.
highlights: Designed and implemented Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) aggregator architecture using React.js, Node.js, and GraphQL, cutting configuration bugs by 50% across web and mobile surfaces.
Partnered with PMs to rapid-prototype and deliver monetization widgets on the ASDA.COM ad platform, driving ~20% incremental revenue growth from digital ads.
Architected state flows using Redux and Redux Reselect selectors for performant client-side data caching.
Maintained and expanded the in-house UI component library ensuring visual uniformity and mobile-first accessibility across checkout and product catalogs.
Drove massive automated test coverage expansion across frontend services utilizing Jest and Enzyme.

work.name: Cisco Systems India Pvt. Ltd.
work.summary: Core UI platform engineering on the Cisco DNA Spaces / DNA-C enterprise network management platform.
highlights: Engineered reusable UI plugins and micro-frontend widgets for the DNA-C platform consumed across multiple independent engineering teams.
Migrated legacy Backbone/jQuery codebase to modern React.js with Redux, custom Hooks, and modern transpilation tooling.
Developed interactive, large-scale network device tree topology visualizers using React, HTML5 Canvas, and GoJS.
Accelerated page loading speed by 30% via route-based lazy loading, React.PureComponent memoization, and image sprite optimizations.
Established strict TDD workflows and SonarQube quality gates during peer reviews, drastically minimizing technical debt and code smells.
Contributed to platform modernization initiatives evaluating React monorepos and micro-frontend architectures to decrease initial bundle overhead.

work.name: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)
work.summary: Enterprise UI development for Marks & Spencer Retail Product Planning (WSSI) platform.
highlights: Developed complex data-intensive enterprise screens supporting multi-cell calculations, filtering, and Excel-like bulk operations.
Implemented predictable global application state management using Angular and NgRx store architecture.
Wrote clean, modular frontend services following the official Angular Style Guide, integrating TypeScript and ES6 patterns.
Constructed reusable cross-team component libraries and design utilities to maintain consistent UI standards across product planning workflows.
Managed enterprise CI/CD integration, branching models, and release pipelines using Git and GitHub.
